channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: How to check a private Ethereum transaction: confirm inclusion
item.description: How to check if a private Ethereum transaction was included: search its hash for a receipt, then read the block number and execution status.

item.title: LP Means Provider, Pool and Claim on Crypto Reserves
item.description: What does LP mean in crypto? It can mean a liquidity provider, a liquidity pool or the LP tokens that represent a provider’s share of its reserves.

item.title: How to set up Flashbots Protect and confirm your first transaction
item.description: Flashbots Protect setup to confirmed transaction: add the Mainnet RPC, sign in MetaMask, track the private transaction on its status page, then confirm its block on Etherscan.

item.title: Fund a Wallet Before Bridging to Monad: Where Funds Go
item.description: What happens to crypto if you fund a wallet before bridging to Monad? Funds stay on the receiving network until you submit a separate bridge transfer.

item.title: Injective Approves Veyra Upgrade Ahead of Nov. 24 Target
item.description: Injective approved Veyra with 99.51% support among non-abstaining votes, targeting a block-triggered Nov. 24 switch to software version 1.21.0.

item.title: How to convert a TRC-20 token to USDT for an exchange deposit
item.description: To convert a TRC-20 token to USDT before withdrawing to an exchange, swap in TronLink through SunSwap, then send USDT over TRON to its deposit address.

item.title: Should I use auto slippage or set it manually for DEX swaps?
item.description: Should you use auto slippage or set it manually? Use auto for common liquid pairs; set it yourself for volatile, thin or taxed tokens, then switch back.

item.title: Injective Veyra upgrade passes vote, targets Nov. 24
item.description: Injective’s Veyra upgrade passed governance with 42.69% turnout and targets a Nov. 24 halt, adding cross-chain and RFQ tools while leaving CypherOS for later.

item.title: Choosing a cross-chain bridge? Run these three checks
item.description: What to look for when choosing a cross-chain bridge: check who controls funds, whether redemption works without its website, and who keeps the route running.

item.title: How Does a Rebasing LST Grow Compared With a Non-Rebasing One?
item.description: A rebasing token in liquid staking adds tokens as rewards arrive; a non-rebasing token keeps your count fixed while each token gains ETH value.

item.title: How to Swap Bridged ETH for SUI on a Sui DEX: Get SUI
item.description: How to swap bridged ETH for SUI on a Sui DEX: connect your wallet, review the route and minimum output, then sign and verify the SUI receipt.

item.title: DOJ targets $1.2B of crypto stolen from Binance
item.description: The DOJ has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance's stolen crypto, while tracing continues across bridges, mixers and exchanges.

item.title: 0x Swap API: Price for browsing, quote for trading
item.description: 0x Swap API price vs quote endpoint difference: use /price while users edit and /quote at confirmation for firm, executable transaction data.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority over more than $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds, while partners have frozen $2.7 billion; recovery remains unresolved.

item.title: Why Was RenBridge Discontinued: The Funding Link That Ended RenVM 1.0
item.description: Why was RenBridge discontinued? Alameda’s collapse with FTX cut RenVM’s funding, forcing the team to sunset version 1.0 and end redemptions for users.

item.title: How to revoke token approvals on BNB Chain for one token
item.description: To revoke token approvals on BNB Chain, select BNB Smart Chain, submit a wallet-signed revocation, then confirm the allowance is zero on-chain with BNB gas ready.

item.title: Automated market maker: how reserves set token prices
item.description: What is an automated market maker in crypto? It prices swaps from pool reserves: each trade changes the reserve ratio, moving the next quoted price.

item.title: Berachain bridge: move ETH to Berachain
item.description: seo_title: How to use Berachain bridge from Ethereum mainnet

item.title: What happens when an AMB destination contract call fails?
item.description: What happens when an AMB destination contract call fails? The receiver’s state change reverts; recovery depends on whether the relay records failure or reverts.

item.title: Wallet Disconnection and TRC-20 Allowances
item.description: Does disconnecting a wallet revoke token approvals? No: an existing TRC-20 allowance stays on-chain until it is spent, changed, or revoked in a transaction.
